name: Sixty-three
summary: A four-player partnership trick-taking auction game where teams bid for trump and race to 250 points.
rules_text: Four players form two opposite teams using a 52-card deck plus joker. Deal 9 cards each in threes, then auction clockwise for trump. Minimum bid 40, maximum 63; if all pass dealer takes it for 25. High bidder chooses trump; if team fails to make bid they lose that many points. All discard non-trump. Dealer refills each hand to six cards from the stock, taking remaining cards; any extra trump beyond six that are worth zero points may be given face-up to partner. Bidding winner must lead trump first trick. Tricks: 4 cards, must follow trump if trump led, otherwise may play any dirt card or trump; trump beats dirt, highest trump wins. Player with no trump may dump remaining cards at once. Points only in trump: Ace 1, King 25, Jack 1, 10 1, 9 9, 5 both colors 5, 2 1 kept by player who played it, Joker 15. Score tricks won, first team to 250 wins.
